उन्न p. p.
1 Wet, wetted, moist.
--2 (fig.) Kind, moved to pity.

; incomplete, insufficient.
--2
Less than (in number, size or
degree); ऊनद्विवर्षं निखनत्

less
than two years old; ऊनं वाभ्यधिकं
वापि

.
--3 Fewer, smaller.
--4 Weaker, inferior; ऊनं न
सत्त्वेष्वधिको बबाधे

.
--5 Minus (in
this sense used with numerals);
[]
एकोन less by one; ˚विंशतिः 20
minus 1 = 19; so ˚त्रिंशत्, 29;
˚पंचाशत् 49; अष्टोनं शतं 100 minus
8 = 92.

उन्नादः Crying out, roar,
humming, chirping &c.

(a) To rise,
appear; उन्नम्योन्नम्य लीयंते दरिद्राणां
मनोरथाः

. (b) To hang over,
arise, impend; उन्नमत्यकालदुर्दिनम्

.
(c) To rise, ascend, go up (fig.
also); उन्नमति नमति वर्षति गर्जति मेघः
[]

. --Caus. (नमयति)
1 To
bend upwards, raise, erect;
मुखमुन्नमय्य

.
--2 (fig.) To elevate, raise to
eminence; उन्नमय बंधुवर्गं

उन्नत p. p.
1 Raised, elevated,
uplifted (fig. also);
उपासितगुरुप्रज्ञाभिमानोन्नताः

.
--तः A
boa (अजगर).
--तं
1 Elevation.
--2
Ascension, altitude.
--Comp.
--आनत
a. elevated and depressed, uneven,
high and low; बंधुरं तून्नतानतं Ak.
--चरण a. with uplifted paws,
rampant.
--नाभि a. having a
projecting navel, i. e. corpulent, fat.
--शिरस् a. carrying the head high,
holding up the head, proud.

उन्नतिः f.
1 Elevation, height (fig.
also); see उन्नतिमत् below.
--2
Exaltation, dignity, rise, prosperity,
increase; स्तोकेनोन्नतिमायाति
स्तोकेनायात्यधोगतिं

.
--3
Raising.
--4 The wife of Garuḍa.
--Comp.
--ईशः N. of Garuḍa (Lord of
उन्नति).

उन्नतिमत् a.
1 Elevated,
projecting, plump (as breasts); सा
पीनोन्नतिमत्पयोधरयुगं धत्ते

उन्नमित p. p.
1 Raised, lifted up.
--2 Heightened, increased, proved
to be superior; ˚उपदेशः

उन्नम्र a. Erect, upright, lofty,
high (fig. also);
उन्नम्रताम्रपटमंडपमंडितं तत् Śi. 5. 68; ˚ता erectness,
uprightness (of the body).

उन्नामः Raising, lifting up;
शतबुद्धिः कृतोन्नामः

उन्नस a. [उन्नता नासिका यस्य]
Having a prominent nose; उन्नसं
दधती वक्त्रं

To tie up, bind up,
fasten round.
--2 To draw out, pull
out.
--3 To come out of, rise from.

उन्नद्ध p. p.
1 Tied or bound up,
fastened; तेऽस्य मुक्तागुणोन्नद्धं
मौलिमंतर्गतस्रजं

.
--3
Unbound.
--4 Elated, flushed with;
वीर्य˚, मद˚, बल˚ &c.

.
--2 Tying up.
--हं Sour
gruel made from the fermentation
of rice.

उन्नाभ a. Having a
projecting navel, corpulent.
--भः N. of a
king of the Solar race.

उन्नाल a. With the stalk
prominently appearing;

उन्नयः, उन्नायः
1 Raising,
elevating.
--2 Height, elevation.
--3
Analogy, resemblance.
--4 Inference.

उन्नयः, उन्नायः
1 Raising,
elevating.
--2 Height, elevation.
--3
Analogy, resemblance.
--4 Inference.

उन्नयन a. With the eyes raised
upwards;

.
--नं
1 Raising,
elevating, lifting up.
--2 Drawing
up water.
--3 The vessel out
of which a fluid is taken.
--4
[]
Leading away, extracting.
--5 Making
straight, smoothing; सीमंत˚.
--6
Deliberation, discussion.
--7
Inference; श्रवणादनु पश्चादीक्षा अन्वीक्षा उन्नयनं.

उन्नायक a.
1 Raising, lifting up.
--2 What leads to an inference or
conclusion.

To leave
deficient or unfinished.
--2 To deduct,
lessen, diminish.
--3 To measure.
--4 To deal out in small quantities.
